hits.snippet: 3 min read time Topics Centific #### Former Granite Asia Partner to Lead Centific's Next Phase of Growth as a Global Data and AI Solutions Provider. Centific, a leading global data and AI solutions company, today announced that Chuen Hong Lew will become Chief Executive Officer, effective August 3, 2026, succeeding Venkat Rangapuram, who has led the company through a period of significant growth and global expansion. Chuen Hong joins Centific from Granite Asia, where he served as a Partner, leading the firm's partnerships ecosystem and special strategic projects. hits.snippet: Centific, the pioneering frontier AI data foundry, announced the appointment of Vasudevan Sundarababu as its Chief Data and AI Officer. His significant contributions to Centific’s innovative platforms and AI data solutions have been pivotal to the company’s success, driving substantial advancements and market differentiation. Venkat Rangapuram, CEO of Centific, commented, “Vasu’s visionary leadership has been a game-changer for us. In his enhanced role, Vasu will spearhead the strategic direction of Centific’s data and AI operations, focusing on refining its flagship platforms—Centific Loop, Pitaya, and OneForma—and expanding its influence across global markets. Reflecting on his new role, Vasu stated, “I am deeply honored by this opportunity to further influence the future of AI and data science at Centific. The landscape is ripe with potential, and I am eager to lead our talented teams to explore new horizons. This critical appointment comes at a time when Centific continues to stand at the vanguard of AI and data processing innovations. The tech industry is witnessing an unprecedented wave of opportunities for groundbreaking advancements.
